verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a full OpenAPI spec and documents API-driven creation of collections and source connections, plus a CLI, MCP server, and search endpoints that mirror UI concepts, strongly suggesting the API is the primary/complete interface. However, there is no explicit documentation stating full feature parity (e.g., billing, webhooks management, auth-provider config) between UI and API. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or docs confirming all UI-only features (dashboard settings, connect widget config) are also API-exposed, and independent verification of parity.
